title: A diary from wartime Nice
episode: “The Scattered Life I Lead” - The Diary of Lucien Dreyfus: a Yad Vashem Podcast [On the Holocaust]
description: Lucien Dreyfus, a Jewish teacher from Strasbourg, kept a diary in Nice, where thousands of Jews had found refuge under Italian occupation. When the Germans arrived in 1943, he was caught in their roundups and deported to Auschwitz.
